title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：symptom　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 symptom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the nurse ① watched the symptom that no sufferer in the ward would have noted, and he said the watching was the whole of the night. The ② symptom, meaning the sign itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a symptom, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ symptom in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ symptom at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A symptom, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the nurse said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the symptom was the whole of the matter, meaning the warning and not the sign. The ⑥ symptom, meaning the warning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; symptom, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a sign and a warning. He said the warning is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ symptom had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ symptom of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of noting; symptom, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ symptom I remember is the sign noted in the report, which closed in 1996 and is still noted as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ symptom, my mother said in 1998, is the only sign that improves by being noted; every symptom, she said, is a warning that has agreed to look like a sign. She said the warning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 症状（指病房里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 症状（指那种症状本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the symptom 观察这一种症状
D. n. 症状（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 症状之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的症状之事）
F. n. 症状（指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 症状、警讯（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 警讯（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the symptom that no sufferer in the ward would have noted
The symptom, meaning the sign itself and not the thermometer
the symptom at the far cupboard
the symptom was the whole of the matter
the symptom had become a line in a report
The symptom of the whole thing
A symptom, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: watch the symptom 意为“观察这一种症状”，1989 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记下的一种症状做了一遍。
symptom 意为“症状”，指那种症状本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
symptom 意为“症状”，指病房里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
symptom 意为“症状”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
symptom 意为“症状、警讯”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种警讯就是那件事的全部。
symptom 意为“警讯”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种症状，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
symptom 意为“症状”，指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1994 年这一种成了护理记录里的一行。
symptom 意为“症状之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的症状之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记下。
symptom 意为“症状”，我记得的是护理记录里记下过的那一种，1996 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一种。
symptom 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，症状是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的症状。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年那位护士观察了病房里没有一位病患肯记下的一种症状，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（watch the symptom）
那种症状，指的是那种症状本身而不是细细的体温计，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。（symptom）
那处病房里每一种症状旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。（symptom）
最远那格药柜那种症状，指的是他们留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（symptom）
叔叔说这种警讯就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种症状。（symptom）
1998 年母亲说，症状是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的症状。（symptom）
